sections.content: Use the pretérito indefinido for completed actions in the past. In this lesson, focus on recognising and producing common regular forms needed to talk about what happened: escribí, viajé, terminé, vivimos. Time expressions such as ayer and el año pasado can help locate the action in the past.

items.spanish: Terminamos el viaje el año pasado.
items.english: We finished the trip last year.

items.spanish: Vivieron en Hanói durante un año.
items.english: They lived in Hanoi for a year.

sections.content: In ir a + infinitive, only ir is conjugated: voy a escribir, vas a escribir, vamos a escribir. Do not conjugate the second verb.
